title: Vintage Gold Green Pear Crystal Wishbone Ring
storyHtml:
A pear of deep green crystal tilts above a delicate wishbone band, with a single clear stone for company. A little heirloom feeling, a little wish waiting to be made.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Pear-cut 5A green zircon with clear zircon accent
